data.action: 穿白和服侧卧沙发，头枕视角膝上闭眼休息，双手自然放松。
data.camera: medium shot, slightly high angle, resting face and supporting lap
data.description: 午后的光穿过伽蓝之堂的百叶窗，落在复古沙发上。两仪式已经把红夹克挂在远处的衣帽架，穿整齐的白色和服侧卧在沙发上，把头安静地枕在你的膝上。她一手放松地搭在自己腰间，另一手蜷在脸旁，眼睛微阖，嘴角只有一点不易察觉的安宁。百叶窗的光斑慢慢移过靠垫，屋里只剩安静的呼吸声。
data.location: 摆放着人偶与古董的伽蓝之堂事务所沙发
data.promptProse: Ryougi Shiki rests sideways on Garan no Dou's vintage sofa, her head on her companion's lap and eyes nearly closed. Her neatly overlapped white kimono and woven dark obi remain intact, one hand at her waist and the other near her face. The slightly high medium framing includes her red jacket on the distant coat rack. Afternoon light through blinds crosses the cushions and cheek, with soft shadows beneath her resting head.
data.title: 两仪式 · 伽蓝之堂的膝枕休憩
